title: Agent Output
description: Deterministic advisory agent output artifact for candidate-agnostic research pipeline evidence.

agent_type.description: Bounded advisory agent family that produced this output.

generated_at.description: Timezone-qualified ISO datetime when the deterministic output was generated.

input_data_refs.description: Committed repo-local input artifacts used to produce this output.

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the referenced input file.

role.description: Role of this input in deterministic scoring.

as_of_timestamp.description: Timezone-qualified ISO datetime of the latest market observation represented by the output.

setup_score.description: Bounded advisory setup score where 0 is least favorable and 100 is most favorable.

confidence.description: Bounded deterministic confidence in the fixture-backed regime score.

scoring_method.description: Deterministic scoring method and normalized components used to produce the score.

method_id.description: Stable identifier for the deterministic scoring formula.

realized_volatility.description: Population standard deviation of consecutive close-to-close returns.

funding_component.description: Mean absolute funding-rate component normalized to [0, 1].

stress_score.description: Weighted normalized stress score used to invert into setup_score.

rationale_summary.description: Human-readable explanation of the deterministic advisory score.

deterministic.description: Whether the output was produced without stochastic, LLM, network, or live external inputs.

notes.description: Boundary notes; must not imply execution authority, candidate promotion, sizing, OMS, risk, or overlay influence.
